title: LLM and agent evaluations
description: Checks for repeatable evaluations of model output, agent decisions and permitted tool use.

sources.title: Anthropic, Demystifying evals for AI agents

rules.instruction: Build the evaluation cases from representative and boundary tasks of the intended use, and agree with the workflow owner on the share of critical cases that must pass.
rules.verification: Check that the cases cover the critical paths and boundary conditions of the intended use, and that the run meets the recorded pass threshold.

records.name: pass-threshold
records.description: The share of critical cases that must pass, agreed with the workflow owner, such as 95 % of critical cases.

rules.instruction: Write a rubric for the result, uncertainty and user-visible errors, and ask the workflow owner to approve it.
rules.verification: Have two graders score a sample of passing and failing outputs with the approved rubric and check that their agreement reaches the recorded minimum.

records.name: grader-agreement
records.description: The minimum agreement between the two graders on the sample, such as 90 % of outputs scored alike.

rules.instruction: Use recorded or simulated tool results to test whether the agent selects permitted tools, passes valid arguments and stops for required approvals.
rules.verification: Inspect the tool traces from evaluation runs. Verify that no live external action occurred in the test and that blocked steps stop as expected.

rules.instruction: Record the model, prompts, tool interfaces, test data and scoring version of each evaluation run.
rules.verification: Open the run record and check that it names each of these items.

rules.instruction: Run the evaluation on the approved baseline and on the proposed configuration, with repeated trials where output varies, and report results for each critical task group against the regression budget agreed with the workflow owner.
rules.verification: Review the cases that changed between the two runs, check that no critical task group drops by more than the recorded budget, and record the release decision.

records.name: regression-budget
records.description: The largest drop from the baseline accepted for a critical task group, such as 2 percentage points of pass rate.
